page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. A marginal note stands in the left margin beside the second paragraph.

main_text.p: alios autem Euangeliftas,alios uerò Doctores & Paftores, &c. Eph.4.11. Idem iudicium eft & de caeteris diuinae τῆς ἀν-τάξεως[?] gradibus. Itaq; fua cuiq; uocatio ftudiofe ornanda, & in ea permanendū eft. 1.Cor.7.24.

Simile.Vt fua cuiq; patria probari debet:nam, ut ille ait, ἄλλος μὲν πρὸς ἄλλην πόλιν τετα-γμένος[?]: ita cuiq; placere debet etiam humilis functio, modò fit diuinitus deman data,feruiatq; gloriae Dei.

Ex hac doctrina eximiae cofolationis fructus ad nos redit. Etenim cum nemo pius fit, qui ignorantiae & infirmitatis suae senfu non pungatur & afficiatur, statim ubi Deum uocantem & idoneos efficie-tem respicimus, opus nostrum in Domi-no nequaquam inane futurum colligi-mus:& recte precamur,

p.i: Da nescia frangi Pectora, da uires animis tua dona profesis.

main_text.p: Colligimus etiam, quàm grauiter illi peccent, qui non contenti suae uocatio-nis limitibus, πολυπραγμονεῖν & ἀλλοτρ[illegible, ~10 letters] agere malunt. Vult enim Deus nos cotendere, ut quieti fimus,& res no-stras agamus, iuxta canone:Καὶ φιλοτιμεῖ-

page.notes: Catchword "σθαι" is the Greek continuation of "φιλοτιμεῖ-" printed at the foot right. Greek readings marked [?] are uncertain at the scan's resolution, notably the first Greek phrase in paragraph 1 (τάξεως), the Greek in paragraph 2, and the Greek after "&" in the list-like line; the illegible span there is not read. Spelling "cofolationis", "senfu", "profesis", "canone:" and "Ex hac" is kept as printed.
